title: Roblox Hi
blurb: Two letters, maximum enthusiasm, pitched somewhere near the ceiling. The squeaky Roblox hi echoes across every lobby ever generated, usually from a player whose avatar is wearing three hats and nothing else. It is friendship at its most efficient — no small talk, no preamble, just immediate wholesome energy directed at a stranger you will betray in about four minutes. Play it on entering any space, digital or physical, to set the tone before anyone can object. The griefing arrives later; the hi is always entirely sincere.
origin: The iconic high-pitched greeting from Roblox voice/chat culture.
